note: Which stations each Amtrak route served on the date of each published system timetable. Read by stationpull.py, which uses the earliest date a pair appears as that service's start year. Only positive observations are recorded: a pair absent here was not found in that timetable, which is not the same as the train not stopping there. Do not read absence as evidence.

source.format: born-digital PDF with a text layer; no OCR involved
source.limits: Amtrak published its last system timetable in June 2018, so this evidence stops there and nothing covers 2019-2025. Years before 2008 exist only as scanned images at timetables.org and would need OCR.
